# telnyx_noise_suppression_engines (Data Source)

The noise suppression engines calls can use.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `noise_suppression_engines` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--noise_suppression_engines))

<a id="nestedatt--noise_suppression_engines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `noise_suppression_engines`

Read-Only:

- `default_attenuation_level` (Number) Default attenuation level of the engine (0-100, in multiples of ten).
- `label` (String) Human-readable name of the engine.
- `value` (String) Machine-readable identifier of the engine, used when configuring noise suppression.
